reason: Keyboard users do open Provide feedback on the live demo: Tab reaches the Customize button (stop 44), Enter opens the menu with focus on its first item, ArrowDown four times lands on Request feature, and Enter opens the panel. The menu items have tabindex -1 by design, as in the APG menu pattern, so Tab skipping them is expected.

Tab or Shift+Tab from the search box closes the search dialog and moves focus to the page, and arrow keys leave the chips alone, so the filter chips and both scroll arrows, Scroll filters right included, are mouse-only and fail 2.1.1. Typing a query, ArrowDown and Enter still find and open every result type, because All groups Pages, Transactions, Accounts, Recipients and Users, so the task is possible but harder without filtering.

On the live demo, Tab reaches the plus button in the Accounts card (stop 50) and both Enter and Space open the Create account dialog. The button sits in a wrapper div with tabindex 0 that is its own tab stop one press earlier, and the sweep's evidence shows focus on that div, where keys do nothing.
